name: plan-store-atomic-rewrite
body: The atomic plan-store rewrite: the transient store is a single `apg/.trans/plans/<project>.jsonl`, so `plan rm --force` and every plan mutation go through `write_through`, which rewrites the whole-record set in one act. A cascade never leaves a half-deleted plan (no orphan task/phase/edge records); a mid-cascade error leaves the original file intact.
